<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>청소년시대연합 (청시대)</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;500;700;900&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --paper: #F5F3EE;
    --paper-raised: #FBFAF7;
    --navy-900: #10233F;
    --navy-700: #1F3A63;
    --blue-500: #3B5D96;
    --seal-red: #A2372B;
    --gold: #A9834E;
    --ink: #1C1B18;
    --ink-soft: #55534C;
    --line: #D9D5C7;
    --line-strong: #B9B4A2;
    --radius: 2px;
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
    scroll-padding-top: 68px;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    html { scroll-behavior: auto; scroll-snap-type: none; }
    * { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
  }

  body {
    background: var(--paper);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    line-height: 1.7;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

  .display {
    font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 900;
  }
  .mono {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .wrap {
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 32px;
  }

  /* ---------- Header ---------- */
  header {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    background: rgba(245, 243, 238, 0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .header-inner {
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 32px;
    height: 68px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .brand-mark {
    height: 30px;
    width: auto;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: block;
  }
  .brand-word {
    font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 17px;
    color: var(--navy-900);
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }
  .brand-word span {
    display: block;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }
  nav ul {
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    gap: 36px;
  }
  nav a {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--navy-700);
    position: relative;
    padding: 4px 0;
  }
  nav a::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; bottom: -2px;
    width: 0; height: 1px;
    background: var(--seal-red);
    transition: width 0.25s ease;
  }
  nav a:hover::after, nav a:focus-visible::after { width: 100%; }
  nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500); outline-offset: 3px; }
  .nav-toggle { display: none; }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero {
    padding: 168px 0 96px;
    position: relative;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
  }
  .hero .wrap { width: 100%; }
  .doc-ref {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 0.1s forwards;
  }
  .doc-ref .dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; background: var(--seal-red); border-radius: 50%; }

  .hero-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
    gap: 48px;
    align-items: end;
  }
  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(38px, 5.2vw, 60px);
    font-weight: 900;
    color: var(--navy-900);
    line-height: 1.28;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.22s forwards;
  }
  .hero h1 em {
    font-style: normal;
    color: var(--seal-red);
  }
  .hero-sub {
    margin-top: 24px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    max-width: 46ch;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.34s forwards;
  }
  .hero-cta {
    margin-top: 32px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.46s forwards;
  }
  .btn {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 13px 26px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-900);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }
  .btn-solid {
    background: var(--navy-900);
    color: var(--paper-raised);
  }
  .btn-solid:hover { background: var(--navy-700); border-color: var(--navy-700); }
  .btn-line:hover { background: var(--navy-900); color: var(--paper-raised); }

  .seal-wrap {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-end;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: sealIn 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) 0.5s forwards;
  }
  .hero-logo {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 300px;
    height: auto;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 24px rgba(16, 35, 63, 0.14));
  }
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  @keyframes sealIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.85) translateY(10px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
  }

  /* ---------- Section shared ---------- */
  section {
    padding: 96px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
  }
  section > .wrap { width: 100%; }
  .eyebrow {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--seal-red);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    display: block;
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 34px);
    color: var(--navy-900);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .section-desc {
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    max-width: 60ch;
    font-size: 15px;
    margin-bottom: 52px;
  }
  .reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px);
    transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease;
  }
  .reveal.is-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

  /* ---------- Charter (mission) ---------- */
  .charter {
    background: var(--paper-raised);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    padding: 56px;
  }
  .charter-head {
    text-align: center;
    padding-bottom: 36px;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  }
  .charter-head .mono { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .charter-head h3 {
    font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--navy-900);
    margin-top: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  }
  .article-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .article {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr;
    gap: 24px;
    padding: 26px 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .article:first-child { border-top: none; padding-top: 0; }
  .article-num {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--seal-red);
    font-weight: 500;
    padding-top: 3px;
  }
  .article h4 {
    font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--navy-900);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .article p { font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--ink-soft); max-width: 58ch; }

  /* ---------- Activities ---------- */
  .activity-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: var(--line-strong);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  }
  .activity-card {
    background: var(--paper-raised);
    padding: 36px;
    transition: background 0.25s ease;
  }
  .activity-card:hover { background: #FFFFFF; }
  .activity-code {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--blue-500);
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .activity-card h4 {
    font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--navy-900);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .activity-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* ---------- Team roster ---------- */
  .roster {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  }
  .roster-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr 2fr;
    gap: 24px;
    padding: 22px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    align-items: baseline;
  }
  .roster-row.head {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    padding-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .roster-row .role {
    font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--navy-900);
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .roster-row .name { font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink); }
  .roster-row .desc { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* ---------- Contact ---------- */
  .contact-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 64px;
  }
  .contact-block dt {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    margin-top: 22px;
  }
  .contact-block dt:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
  .contact-block dd {
    font-size: 15.5px;
    color: var(--navy-900);
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  .signature {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-top: 40px;
  }
  .sig-line { text-align: right; }
  .sig-line .role { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .sig-line .name { font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: var(--navy-900); margin-top: 2px; }

  .link-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .link-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 16px 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 14.5px;
    transition: padding-left 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .link-row:first-child { border-top: none; }
  .link-row:hover { padding-left: 8px; color: var(--seal-red); }
  .link-row .arrow { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; }

  /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
  footer {
    padding: 40px 0;
    background: var(--navy-900);
    color: #C8CEDA;
  }
  .footer-inner {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 16px;
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }
  .footer-inner .mono { color: #8A93A8; }

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .header-inner { padding: 0 20px; }
    nav ul { display: none; }
    .wrap { padding: 0 20px; }
    .hero { padding: 128px 0 64px; }
    .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .seal-wrap { justify-content: flex-start; margin-top: 32px; }
    .charter { padding: 32px 22px; }
    .article { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
    .activity-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .roster-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; }
    .roster-row.head { display: none; }
    .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
    .signature { justify-content: flex-start; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="header-inner">
    <a href="#top" class="brand">
      <img class="brand-mark" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="청소년시대연합 로고">
      <span class="brand-word">청시대<span>청소년시대연합</span></span>
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="주 메뉴">
      <ul>
        <li><a href="#mission">소개</a></li>
        <li><a href="#activities">활동</a></li>
        <li><a href="#team">구성원</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contact">연락처</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="hero" style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:168px;">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span class="doc-ref mono"><span class="dot"></span>문서번호 청시대-2026-001 · 단체 소개 자료</span>
      <div class="hero-grid">
        <div>
          <h1 class="display">청소년의 목소리로,<br><em>다음 시대</em>를 씁니다.</h1>
          <p class="hero-sub">청소년시대연합(청시대)은 청소년이 스스로 목소리를 내고, 지역사회와 정책 현장에서 실질적인 변화를 만들어가는 청소년 주도 연합체입니다.</p>
          <div class="hero-cta">
            <a href="#mission" class="btn btn-solid">단체 소개 보기</a>
            <a href="#contact" class="btn btn-line">문의하기</a>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="seal-wrap">
          <img class="hero-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="청소년시대연합(청시대) 로고">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- MISSION / CHARTER -->
  <section id="mission">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span class="eyebrow mono">ABOUT</span>
      <h2 class="section-title display">단체 소개</h2>
      <p class="section-desc">청시대가 어떤 원칙으로 활동하는지, 설립 취지문을 헌장 형식으로 정리했습니다.</p>

      <div class="charter reveal">
        <div class="charter-head">
          <span class="mono">청소년시대연합 설립 취지문</span>
          <h3>헌&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;장</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="article-list">
          <div class="article">
            <span class="article-num mono">제1조</span>
            <div>
              <h4>목적</h4>
              <p>본 연합은 청소년이 자신의 삶과 지역사회, 정책 결정 과정에 주체적으로 참여할 수 있는 기반을 마련함을 목적으로 한다.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="article">
            <span class="article-num mono">제2조</span>
            <div>
              <h4>활동 원칙</h4>
              <p>청시대의 모든 활동은 청소년 당사자의 제안과 결정을 우선하며, 특정 세대나 기관의 시각이 아닌 청소년의 시각에서 출발한다.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="article">
            <span class="article-num mono">제3조</span>
            <div>
              <h4>연대와 확장</h4>
              <p>지역 청소년 단체, 학교, 지자체와 폭넓게 연대하며, 한 지역의 성공적인 활동 모델을 다른 지역으로 확산하는 것을 지향한다.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="article">
            <span class="article-num mono">제4조</span>
            <div>
              <h4>투명성</h4>
              <p>연합의 활동 내역과 재정 운영은 회원과 후원자에게 정기적으로 공개하며, 모든 의사결정 과정을 기록으로 남긴다.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ACTIVITIES -->
  <section id="activities">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span class="eyebrow mono">PROGRAMS</span>
      <h2 class="section-title display">활동 · 프로그램</h2>
      <p class="section-desc">청시대는 아래 네 개의 상시 프로그램을 중심으로 활동합니다. 각 프로그램은 지역 지부별로 자율적으로 운영됩니다.</p>

      <div class="activity-grid reveal">
        <div class="activity-card">
          <span class="activity-code mono">PROGRAM 01</span>
          <h4>청소년 정책 제안단</h4>
          <p>지역 현안을 조사하고 정책 제안서를 작성해 지자체·교육청에 직접 전달하는 상설 활동입니다.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="activity-card">
          <span class="activity-code mono">PROGRAM 02</span>
          <h4>또래 상담 네트워크</h4>
          <p>훈련받은 청소년 또래 상담가가 학교·지역 커뮤니티에서 정기 상담 창구를 운영합니다.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="activity-card">
          <span class="activity-code mono">PROGRAM 03</span>
          <h4>지역 연대 캠페인</h4>
          <p>환경, 인권, 안전 등 지역 현안에 대해 청소년 주도로 캠페인을 기획하고 실행합니다.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="activity-card">
          <span class="activity-code mono">PROGRAM 04</span>
          <h4>청소년 리더십 아카데미</h4>
          <p>회의 진행, 토론, 기획서 작성 등 단체 운영에 필요한 실무 역량을 함께 배우는 교육 과정입니다.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- TEAM -->
  <section id="team">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span class="eyebrow mono">MEMBERS</span>
      <h2 class="section-title display">구성원 소개</h2>
      <p class="section-desc">청시대 운영진 명단입니다. 실제 이름과 소개는 자유롭게 채워 넣어 사용해 주세요.</p>

      <div class="roster reveal">
        <div class="roster-row head">
          <span>직책</span><span>이름</span><span>소개</span>
        </div>
        <div class="roster-row">
          <span class="role">대표</span>
          <span class="name">이름을 입력하세요</span>
          <span class="desc">연합의 전반적인 방향을 이끌고 대외 협력을 총괄합니다.</span>
        </div>
        <div class="roster-row">
          <span class="role">부대표</span>
          <span class="name">이름을 입력하세요</span>
          <span class="desc">지역 지부 간 소통과 내부 운영을 조율합니다.</span>
        </div>
        <div class="roster-row">
          <span class="role">정책팀장</span>
          <span class="name">이름을 입력하세요</span>
          <span class="desc">정책 제안단 활동을 기획하고 자료를 검토합니다.</span>
        </div>
        <div class="roster-row">
          <span class="role">홍보팀장</span>
          <span class="name">이름을 입력하세요</span>
          <span class="desc">캠페인 기획과 온라인 채널 운영을 담당합니다.</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- CONTACT -->
  <section id="contact">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span class="eyebrow mono">CONTACT</span>
      <h2 class="section-title display">연락처 · 외부 채널</h2>
      <p class="section-desc">문의나 제휴 제안은 아래 연락처로, 활동 소식은 외부 채널에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.</p>

      <div class="contact-grid reveal">
        <div>
          <dl class="contact-block">
            <dt>이메일</dt>
            <dd>contact@cheongsidae.example</dd>
            <dt>전화</dt>
            <dd>02-0000-0000</dd>
            <dt>주소</dt>
            <dd>서울특별시 (상세 주소를 입력하세요)</dd>
          </dl>
          <div class="signature">
            <div class="sig-line">
              <div class="role">청소년시대연합 대표</div>
              <div class="name">이름을 입력하세요 (인)</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="link-list">
          <a href="#" class="link-row">공식 블로그 <span class="arrow mono">→</span></a>
          <a href="#" class="link-row">인스타그램 <span class="arrow mono">→</span></a>
          <a href="#" class="link-row">유튜브 채널 <span class="arrow mono">→</span></a>
          <a href="#" class="link-row">카카오톡 채널 문의 <span class="arrow mono">→</span></a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

</main>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap footer-inner">
    <span>&copy; 2026 청소년시대연합(청시대). All rights reserved.</span>
    <span class="mono">비영리 청소년 단체 · 등록번호 입력</span>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
  const els = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add('is-visible');
        io.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });
  els.forEach(el => io.observe(el));
</script>

</body>
</html>
